title: Ali Toot Gaya Hai
body:
Nauha ( Ali toot gaya hai..)
By: Ali Akbar Ameen..(2018)
Haye mazlooma...2x
Haye mehrooma..2x
Ghum teri judayi ka mujhe aisa mila hai, (zahra tere jane se ali toot gaya hai)..2x
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Is tarha kati umr tumhari mere ghar me)..2x
Chakki kabhi pisi to kabhi faka kiya hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. (Aaram kabhi tumne mere ghar nahi paya)..2x
Sharminda Ali tumse nabi-zaadi hua hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. (Kar kar tujhe yaad bohat roya tadap kar)..2x
Jab bhi tere Shabbir ne haa pani piya hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. (Baki nahi pasli jo shikasta na hui ho)..2x
Pehlu pe kuch is tarha se darvaza gira hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. (Is baat ko hargiz na kabhi bhul saku ga)..2x
Ban kar ke Ali qaidi Madine me phira hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. (Maaloom yeh hota hai bohot dard tha tab hi)..2x
Pehlu se tera haath abhi tak na utha hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. (Aye binte Payambar tujhe Hasnain ki madar)..2x
Kis tarha kiya dafn mere dil ko pata hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. (Dar tujhpe giraya tera pehlu kiya zakhmi)..2x
Yeh meri adalat ka diya tujhko silaa hai..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
9. (Har baar ibaadat me tumhe roya hoo zahra)..2x
Jab bhi teri tasbeeh ko musalle pe pardha hay..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
10. (Nauha yahi padhte hay najaf dekh ke haider)..2x
Zahra teri turbat par naa saayaa na diyaa hay..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
11. (Zainab se chupaya gam e darbaar ko lekar)..2x
Baalo ki safedi ka sabab mujhko pataa hay..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
12. (Mohsin ki shahaadat ko bhalaa bhuloo may kayse)..2x
Ye wo tha diya jalne se pehle jo bujhaa hay..
Zahra tere jane...
<<DIVIDER>>
13. (Aankho'n se rava ashk the danish mere us waqt)..2x
Jiz waqt ke kirtaas pe yeh jumla likha hai..
Zahra tere jane...
